en.text: On the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it with all its furniture, and the altar with all its vessels, and had anointed and sanctified them;

zhSimplified.text: 摩西立完了帐幕，就把帐幕用膏抹了，使它成圣，又把其中的器具和坛，并坛上的器具，都抹了，使它成圣。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西立完了帳幕，就把帳幕用膏抹了，使它成聖，又把其中的器具和壇，並壇上的器具，都抹了，使它成聖。

en.text: the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, gave offerings. These were the princes of the tribes. These are they who were over those who were counted;

zhSimplified.text: 当天，以色列的众首领，就是各族的族长，都来奉献。他们是各支派的首领，管理那些被数的人。

zhTraditional.text: 當天，以色列的眾首領，就是各族的族長，都來奉獻。他們是各支派的首領，管理那些被數的人。

en.text: and they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox. They presented them before the tabernacle.

zhSimplified.text: 他们把自己的供物送到耶和华面前，就是六辆篷子车和十二只公牛。每两个首领奉献一辆车，每首领奉献一只牛。他们把这些都奉到帐幕前。

zhTraditional.text: 他們把自己的供物送到耶和華面前，就是六輛篷子車和十二隻公牛。每兩個首領奉獻一輛車，每首領奉獻一隻牛。他們把這些都奉到帳幕前。

en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：

en.text: “Accept these from them, that they may be used in doing the service of the Tent of Meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service.”

zhSimplified.text: 「你要收下这些，好作会幕的使用，都要照利未人所办的事交给他们。」

zhTraditional.text: 「你要收下這些，好作會幕的使用，都要照利未人所辦的事交給他們。」

en.text: Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.

zhSimplified.text: 于是摩西收了车和牛，交给利未人，

zhTraditional.text: 於是摩西收了車和牛，交給利未人，

en.text: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.

zhSimplified.text: 把两辆车，四只牛，照革顺子孙所办的事交给他们，

zhTraditional.text: 把兩輛車，四隻牛，照革順子孫所辦的事交給他們，

en.text: He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

zhSimplified.text: 又把四辆车，八只牛，照米拉利子孙所办的事交给他们；他们都在祭司亚伦的儿子以他玛手下。

zhTraditional.text: 又把四輛車，八隻牛，照米拉利子孫所辦的事交給他們；他們都在祭司亞倫的兒子以他瑪手下。

en.text: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.

zhSimplified.text: 但车与牛都没有交给哥辖子孙；因为他们办的是圣所的事，在肩头上抬圣物。

zhTraditional.text: 但車與牛都沒有交給哥轄子孫；因為他們辦的是聖所的事，在肩頭上抬聖物。

en.text: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed. The princes gave their offerings before the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 用膏抹坛的日子，首领都来行奉献坛的礼，众首领就在坛前献供物。

zhTraditional.text: 用膏抹壇的日子，首領都來行奉獻壇的禮，眾首領就在壇前獻供物。

en.text: The LORD said to Moses, “They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：「众首领为行奉献坛的礼，要每天一个首领来献供物。」

en.text: This was the dedication offering of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;

zhSimplified.text: 用膏抹坛的日子，以色列的众首领为行献坛之礼所献的是：银盘子十二个，银碗十二个，金盂十二个；

zhTraditional.text: 用膏抹壇的日子，以色列的眾首領為行獻壇之禮所獻的是：銀盤子十二個，銀碗十二個，金盂十二個；

en.text: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

zhSimplified.text: 每盘子重一百三十舍客勒，每碗重七十舍客勒。一切器皿的银子，按圣所的平，共有二千四百舍客勒。

zhTraditional.text: 每盤子重一百三十舍客勒，每碗重七十舍客勒。一切器皿的銀子，按聖所的平，共有二千四百舍客勒。

en.text: the twelve golden ladles, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;

zhSimplified.text: 十二个金盂盛满了香，按圣所的平，每盂重十舍客勒，所有的金子共一百二十舍客勒。

zhTraditional.text: 十二個金盂盛滿了香，按聖所的平，每盂重十舍客勒，所有的金子共一百二十舍客勒。

en.text: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering;

zhSimplified.text: 作燔祭的，共有公牛十二只，公羊十二只，一岁的公羊羔十二只，并同献的素祭作赎罪祭的公山羊十二只；

zhTraditional.text: 作燔祭的，共有公牛十二隻，公羊十二隻，一歲的公羊羔十二隻，並同獻的素祭作贖罪祭的公山羊十二隻；

en.text: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings: twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering of the altar, after it was anointed.

zhSimplified.text: 作平安祭的，共有公牛二十四只，公绵羊六十只，公山羊六十只，一岁的公羊羔六十只。这就是用膏抹坛之后，为行奉献坛之礼所献的。

zhTraditional.text: 作平安祭的，共有公牛二十四隻，公綿羊六十隻，公山羊六十隻，一歲的公羊羔六十隻。這就是用膏抹壇之後，為行奉獻壇之禮所獻的。

en.text: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西进会幕要与耶和华说话的时候，听见法柜的施恩座以上、二基路伯中间有与他说话的声音，就是耶和华与他说话。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西進會幕要與耶和華說話的時候，聽見法櫃的施恩座以上、二基路伯中間有與他說話的聲音，就是耶和華與他說話。
